payload.text: ST0091/03, the tap and the macOS assets publish through the built-ins and Intent's own stage, dc's; vc judges it and claims nothing. Banked at refs/bank/dc/st0091/wp03-v1 (blob d168a870bb99, patch-id 6f6bb9badad3), a diff from wp02-v1's tip tree (e7e4a09572b8); the train's tip is 0522909e90fe. To vc decision 118: bin/.devbin/cut/publish is the first after: command (pair at the tag, Intent's macos prepare and publish, release attach for the sums, the built-in formula publish --pull), stopping at the first failure and safe to run again; brew smoke --at-tag is the second, saying the publish did not finish when the tap is not at the tag's version. The formula and the cask are templates under packaging/homebrew/, rendered by the built-in in assets mode, with 0667's service fix; macos prepare refuses a pair that is not a release build of HEAD (F1); cmd/brew keeps the smoke alone and brew.lib the names. The rendered formula and cask pass brew style in a throwaway tap. The whole train's dry run on a scratch clone passes pre-flight and names both after: commands. release_publish.bats and brew_formula.bats are red, every arm, on the tree before it. AT-03.1 and AT-03.2 to-write; AT-03.3 at the landing.
